I farm barley on this rented plot in Oromia highlands, and with 6.78 hectares total I have some means but must be careful with cash since the land is not mine. I will use DAP and urea like the cooperative provides, though not a heavy dose because fertilizer is expensive and often comes late. I keep some cattle so I spread manure when I can, and I save my own barley seed from last harvest since improved barley seed is hard to find here. No irrigation — I depend on the meher rains — and pests are not usually a big problem on barley so I will not spend on chemicals.
